Carini Group is a boutique brokerage. It offers personalized, high-touch service that large firms cannot match. The firm has strong international reach — 50% of its business comes from clients outside the United States. Alex Carini, the founder, is fluent in English, Italian, and Spanish. This makes the firm well-suited for international buyers and sellers who want a trusted contact in New York City.

Carini Group earns commissions on completed real estate transactions. On sales, this is typically a percentage of the sale price, split between the buyer's and seller's brokers. On rentals, commissions are typically one month's rent or 15% of annual rent, paid by the landlord or tenant depending on the deal structure.

The ideal client is a high-net-worth individual, business executive, or investor who needs to buy, sell, or rent property in New York City. Many clients have international ties — particularly from Europe, South America, and Asia. The firm is especially well-suited for clients who need a broker who speaks Italian or Spanish, or who requires guidance navigating the NYC market from abroad.
Luxury brands and hospitality (e.g., Lamborghini representation on record)

Carini Group serves both individual clients (one person or family) and institutional buyers (companies, funds, and developers). Deal sizes range from under $500,000 for a studio co-op to over $100 million for ultra-luxury condos. The rental book spans from $3,750/month apartments to $140,000/month luxury townhouses.

For sellers: Alex or an agent visits the property, conducts a market assessment, sets a price, arranges photography, and lists the property on the RLS and the Carini Group website.

For buyers: The agent gathers preferences and budget, then searches and presents matching properties. No mortgage pre-approval is required to view properties (per the firm's Standardized Operating Procedures). No exclusive brokerage agreement is required.
For landlords: The agent markets the rental unit, screens and vets tenants before showings, and handles lease documentation.

Carini Group manages the full transaction lifecycle. The agent acts as the central coordinator between the client, the counterparty, attorneys, title companies, mortgage brokers, and any other parties. The firm project-manages every step from listing to closing.

The firm prides itself on responsiveness. Client testimonials highlight that Alex is always available, answers questions clearly, and provides updates throughout the process. Communication happens by phone (917-833-4388), email (Alex@CariniGroup.Com), and in-person meetings.

Carini Group is a small, high-performance real estate brokerage in New York City. It is led by Alex Carini, who is the founder, primary broker, and public face of the firm.

The firm earns money by helping clients buy, sell, and rent property in New York City. It charges commissions on closed deals. It also provides investment advisory and property management services to repeat clients.

Half of its clients are from outside the United States — primarily from Europe and Latin America. Alex's ability to speak English, Italian, and Spanish, combined with his deep media presence in Italian-language media, gives the firm a unique edge with international buyers and sellers.
The firm operates as a boutique: a small team, personal relationships, and direct access to the founder for every significant deal. This is its main competitive advantage over larger brokerages.

Day to day, agents receive inquiries, search listings, conduct viewings, negotiate offers, and coordinate all parties through to closing. The firm project-manages every transaction — acting as the central hub between clients, attorneys, banks, and contractors.
The firm's marketing relies on referrals, media appearances, LinkedIn, and community events. It does not appear to run significant paid advertising campaigns.

For B2B partners, the most valuable areas of support are: CRM and lead management tools, digital marketing (especially for international audiences), transaction management technology, photography and staging services, and sales support for outbound prospecting. The firm is growing and actively hiring — there is appetite for new tools and partnerships that increase deal volume and client reach.
